dataset_name: THE RIPPLE — Campus Crisis Recovery Dataset

file_purpose.activities.csv: Activity timetable, windows, duration, requirements, priorities, staffing, move/cancel policy
file_purpose.rooms.csv: Room capacity, features, in-charge, facilitator requirements
file_purpose.services.csv: Every building service type has an explicit state
file_purpose.room_services.csv: Maps each room to location-specific service instances
file_purpose.activity_modes.csv: Approved operating modes; fallback modes are explicit and limited
file_purpose.dependencies.csv: Hard prerequisites and soft continuity relationships
file_purpose.staff_directory.csv: Qualified faculty/support/technical event staff and availability/breaks
file_purpose.staff_assignments.csv: Baseline staff assignments, movable by solver if qualified
file_purpose.engineering_personnel.csv: Facility Engineering skills, rates, windows, secondary skills
file_purpose.work_requests.csv: Repair tasks, service targets, prerequisites, parts and verification
file_purpose.service_repair_map.csv: Explicit mapping from work requests to service-state changes
file_purpose.incident.json: Incident timeline, assumptions and scenario variants

policy_update: Essential and mandatory activities cannot be cancelled; only designated optional activities may be cancelled with their existing penalties.
contents_note: Input data and public scenario rules only. Organizer audits, solution timetables, and policy-validation results are excluded.
